# Acme Clinic test catalog

One file per epic, under a service folder: `clinic-backend/`, `vendor-api/` (areas nest one more level, e.g. `vendor-api/partners/`).
Copy [_template.md](_template.md) to start a new epic. This README and files starting with `_` are not parsed.
